restaurant_profile.name: Voix Wings Demo
restaurant_profile.disclaimer: Demo catalog for VoixAI reliability testing. Not an official Wingstop menu.

validation_rules.description: All required_slots must be filled before pricing/confirmation
Referenced item must exist in catalog
Item must be marked as available
Referenced flavor must exist in catalog
Flavor must be marked as available
Flavor must be allowed for the item type being ordered
Number of flavors selected must not exceed max_flavors for the item
Referenced modifier option must exist in catalog
Modifier option must be available
Modifier group must be applicable to the item type being ordered
All flats piece preference is only available for classic bone-in wings
All drums piece preference is only available for classic bone-in wings
Piece preference modifier is only available for classic bone-in wings
Cook preference must be valid for the selected item type
Combo orders must include a side selection
Combo orders must include a drink selection
Group pack orders must specify classic or boneless wing type
Group pack flavor count must not exceed max_flavors
Fry items cannot have wing flavor selections applied
Drink items cannot have cook preference modifiers applied
Dessert items cannot have cook preference modifiers applied
Half and half flavor split is only valid when max_flavors is at least 2

pricing_rules.description: All flats and all drums piece preference selections incur an additional charge
Upgrading to a premium side option in a combo incurs additional charge
Dips ordered beyond the included_dip_count are charged individually
Fry add-on selections incur additional charges
Tax is applied at the configured tax_rate on the subtotal
Line item total is base price plus modifier deltas multiplied by quantity
